decisions.reason: The kitchen-cabinet arrangement question does not change Unit 2 bathroom placement or design obligations.
The kitchen-cabinet arrangement question does not change Unit 3 bathroom placement or requirements.

The drawing deliverable already requires kitchen-cabinet placement; the new open-concept cabinetry context belongs to the separate cabinetry Requirement and does not necessarily change the drawing's format or required-content list.
The cabinetry layout context does not change the required count of three independent dwellings.
